caption:
Build a login screen out of divs in your machine coding round, and the interviewer's first Enter key does nothing.

Look at the card. Pressing Enter in a text field submits the form that field belongs to. The HTML spec calls this implicit submission. With no <form>, there's nothing to submit, so Enter does nothing. The Go key on a phone keyboard does the same thing as Enter, so it does nothing too.

Wrap the fields in a form, handle onSubmit, and call e.preventDefault() first. A button inside a form submits by default, so clicking still works.

One handler now covers the click, Enter and the phone's Go key.

Source: MDN, The Form element; HTML Standard, implicit submission.
